{{Quote|This ship is now property of the Galactic Empire. You are all my prisoners. Take them away.''"<br />"''This is Captain Sortuli. I'm trapped in the bridge 'fresher, and they'll discover me any moment. Our hyperdrive has coordinates to the Rebel fleet. We cannot let that information fall into Imperial hands. Your team is our only hope.|TJ-11 and Captain Hylo Sortuli, over the ''Shadow Raptor''{{'s}} comms|<ref name="DitW" />}}
During the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], a group [[Alliance to Restore the Republic]] collected a shipment of [[Droid/Legends|droids]] from [[Port Tooga]] and returned them to the [[Alliance Intelligence/Legends|Alliance Intelligence]] [[EF76 Nebulon-B escort frigate]] ''[[Shadow Raptor]]''. Unbeknownst to the Rebels, the droid in fact served [[Imperial Intelligence/Legends|Imperial Intelligence]] and '''revolted''' once they were onboard the [[Frigate/Legends|frigate]], managing to take control of the [[Starship/Legends|ship]] as it began drifting toward a [[Black hole/Legends|black hole]]. [[TJ-11]], leader of the droids, intended to escape the doomed ship with rebel [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Hylo Sortuli]] and [[Navigator/Legends|navigator]] [[Tay Coomsay]], but the agents who had delivered the droids were able to successfully defeat the [[Tactical droid/Legends|tactical droid]], rescue the captives, and retake the ship, saving it from the black hole.<ref name="DitW" />
